spacesuit-mk2.name: Spacesuit MK2
spacesuit-mk2.description: +1 Defense. +1 Endurance. Allows movement along the ship's outer hull between airlocks.

gu4-rd.name: GU4-RD
gu4-rd.description: Before attacking, roll 1 die. On a success, deal 1 damage to the enemy.

medic-bag.name: Field Medic's Bag
medic-bag.description: Spend an action and credits to heal yourself or another player in your space or an adjacent space (1 credit = 1 health).

backpack.name: Backpack
backpack.description: Allows you to carry 2 additional items.

pistol.name: Pistol
pistol.description: +2 combat strength. Reroll one die once per attack.

smuggler-mark.name: Smuggler's Mark
smuggler-mark.description: Get a 2-credit discount on any purchase. You may trade one item with any player anywhere on the map as an action.

circular-saw.name: Circular Saw
circular-saw.description: Up to 2 rerolls of one die per attack.

laser-cutter.name: Laser Cutter
laser-cutter.description: After you kill an enemy, deal 1 damage to all enemies in the same sector.

exo-gloves.name: Exo Gloves
exo-gloves.description: In combat, any pair of matching die results adds 1 hit.

pneumo-cannon.name: Pneumatic Cannon
pneumo-cannon.description: +1 combat strength. A roll of 3 counts as a hit; a 6 deals damage to both the enemy and the character.

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.description: +3 combat strength. Enemies leave no loot.

knife.name: Knife
knife.description: +1 combat strength. If you score no hits during an attack, take 1 damage.

ultrasonic-hammer.name: Ultrasonic Hammer
ultrasonic-hammer.description: +4 combat strength. After defeating an enemy, spend 5 credits to recharge.

spacesuit.name: Spacesuit
spacesuit.description: +1 defense. Allows movement along the ship’s outer hull between airlocks.

last-chance.name: Last Chance
last-chance.description: +1 combat strength. If you score no hits during an attack, deal 1 damage to that enemy.

laser-scalpel.name: Laser Scalpel
laser-scalpel.description: +1 Science. In combat, use your Science instead of Strength.

pipe-wrench.name: Pipe Wrench
pipe-wrench.description: +1 combat strength. +1 Repair. You may reroll any number of dice during a Repair check.

shooter-helmet.name: Marksman’s Helmet
shooter-helmet.description: In combat, a die result of 3 counts as a hit.

implant-agility.name: Implant A
implant-agility.description: +1 Agility. Can be transferred, takes no backpack slot, cannot be removed after use; maximum of 2 implants in use.

implant-endurance.name: Implant B
implant-endurance.description: +1 Endurance. Can be transferred, takes no backpack slot, cannot be removed after use; maximum of 2 implants in use.

implant-repair.name: Implant R
implant-repair.description: +1 Repair. Can be transferred, takes no backpack slot, cannot be removed after use; maximum of 2 implants in use.

implant-science.name: Implant N
implant-science.description: +1 Science. Can be transferred, takes no backpack slot, cannot be removed after use; maximum of 2 implants in use.

implant-strength.name: Implant S
implant-strength.description: +1 Strength. Can be transferred, takes no backpack slot, cannot be removed after use; maximum of 2 implants in use.

ghb-dtn.name: GHB-DTN
ghb-dtn.description: During your turn, you may exhaust this robot to move yourself or an ally up to 2 sectors.

r69-nic3.name: R69-NIC3
r69-nic3.description: During your turn, you may exhaust this robot to ignore all non-boss enemy abilities until the end of the round.

gtu-b1c4.name: GTU-B1c4
gtu-b1c4.description: In combat, you may exhaust this robot to add 1 hit to an enemy.

c6-car-courier.name: C6-CAR “Courier”
c6-car-courier.description: During your turn, you may exhaust this robot to trade any number of items with another player anywhere on the map.

sc0-u7.name: SC0-U7
sc0-u7.description: During your turn, you may exhaust this robot to reveal any map tile.

prot2-ct.name: PROT2-CT
prot2-ct.description: In combat, you may exhaust this robot to gain +1 Defense until the end of the round.

alarm-bot.name: ALARM BOT
alarm-bot.description: During your turn, you may exhaust this robot to ignore all non-boss enemy abilities until the end of the round.

sc13-nc3.name: SC13-NC3
sc13-nc3.description: During a Science or Repair check, you may exhaust this robot to reroll all dice.

f1t-b07.name: F1T-B07
f1t-b07.description: During an Endurance or Agility check, you may exhaust this robot to reroll all dice.

prot3-ct.name: PROT3-CT
prot3-ct.description: You may exhaust this robot to ignore any damage until the end of the round.

h3-al.name: H3-AL
h3-al.description: During your turn, you may exhaust this robot to restore 3 health to yourself or an ally.

brass-knuckles.name: Makeshift Knuckles
brass-knuckles.description: During an attack, you may take 2 damage to add 1 hit.

old-cloak.name: Old Cloak
old-cloak.description: +1 Defense. Healing effects restore 1 additional health.

assault-rifle.name: Assault Rifle
assault-rifle.description: +2 combat strength. Once per attack, reroll any number of dice.

shotgun.name: Shotgun
shotgun.description: +3 combat strength. After attacking, if a non-boss enemy survives, push it up to 2 open spaces in any direction.

drg-4u.name: DRG-4U
drg-4u.description: Carry 2 additional items. During a Strength check or attack, you may exhaust this robot to reroll all dice.

swiss-army-knife.name: Swiss Army Knife
swiss-army-knife.description: +1 Strength, Science, Repair, Endurance and Agility. It also has a corkscrew.

plague-doctor-mask.name: Plague Doctor Mask
plague-doctor-mask.description: +1 Defense. Completely prevents damage from boils.

nanobots.name: Nanobots
nanobots.description: Discard to restore 1 health and gain +1 Defense until the end of the round.

air-canister.name: Air Canister
air-canister.description: Discard this card and spend an action to move once between airlocks.

adrenaline-supply.name: Adrenaline
adrenaline-supply.description: During your turn, discard this card to gain 1 additional action.

defibrillator.name: Defibrillator
defibrillator.description: During your turn, discard this card to reroll any number of dice.

dry-rations.name: Dry Rations
dry-rations.description: During your turn, you may discard this card to restore 4 health.

tripwire.name: Tripwire
tripwire.description: Spend an action and place this in your sector to kill one non-boss enemy that appears there or enters it.

gas-cylinder.name: Gas Cylinder
gas-cylinder.description: Spend an action and discard this card to kill one non-boss enemy in your sector.

door-remote.name: Door Remote
door-remote.description: Spend 1 action and 2 credits to remotely open or close any corridor passage.

flashlight.name: Flashlight
flashlight.description: You do not spend a step to reveal a map tile when entering it.

medkit.name: Medkit
medkit.description: During your turn, you may discard this card to restore all health.

proton-shield.name: Proton Shield
proton-shield.description: During your turn, discard this card to prevent all damage until the end of the round.

water.name: Water
water.description: During your turn, you may discard this card to restore 3 health.

ration.name: Ration
ration.description: During your turn, you may discard this card to restore 5 health.

adrenaline-x.name: Adrenaline-X
adrenaline-x.description: During your turn, discard this card to gain 2 additional actions.

power-cell.name: Power Cell
power-cell.description: During your turn, discard this card to ready one of your robots.

science-stimulant.name: Science Stimulant
science-stimulant.description: During a Science check, discard this card to reroll 1 die.

agility-stimulant.name: Agility Stimulant
agility-stimulant.description: During an Agility check, discard this card to reroll 1 die.

endurance-stimulant.name: Endurance Stimulant
endurance-stimulant.description: During an Endurance check, discard this card to reroll 1 die.

repair-stimulant.name: Repair Stimulant
repair-stimulant.description: During a Repair check, discard this card to reroll 1 die.

strength-stimulant.name: Strength Stimulant
strength-stimulant.description: During a Strength check, discard this card to reroll 1 die.

drekovac.name: Drekovac
drekovac.description: Slow but strong enemy. The player’s combat strength is reduced by 1.

vurdalak.name: Vurdalak
vurdalak.description: A resilient enemy: it restores all health if not killed during the turn.

plagued.name: Plagued
plagued.description: An enemy afflicted by boils: when it dies, it leaves 1 boil in each adjacent space.

nest.name: Nest
nest.description: A stationary enemy. Instead of attacking, it spreads boils.

likho.name: Likho
likho.description: A stationary enemy that blocks passages.

pack.name: Pack
pack.description: Several small enemies. Can move through vents.

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.description: A nimble, fast enemy. The player’s combat strength is reduced by 1.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
ghoul.description: An advanced form of the Restless. Can move through vents.

seeker.name: Seeker
seeker.description: Hunts the player with the lowest health. Can move through vents.

restless.name: Restless
restless.description: Infected human. The player’s combat strength is reduced by 1.

mother.name: Mother
mother.description: Boss. Attacks ignore defense. Health and attack increase by 1 for each player.

viy.name: Viy
viy.description: Boss. Health and attack increase by 1 for each player.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.description: Boss. Health and attack increase by 1 for each living monster in play.

leshy.name: Leshy
leshy.description: Boss. Flees from players and leaves 2 boils in its space before its turn.

boil.name: Boil
boil.description: A stationary gas bubble. It bursts and dies when it shares a space with a player.

researcher.name: Researcher
researcher.description: All map tiles are open simultaneously.

cabin-noise.name: Cabin Noise
cabin-noise.description: As you pass a cabin, you hear a commotion inside.

o1.success: You open an empty cabin and find a bag hanging from a squeaky hook. Draw a Supply card.
o1.failure: The door flies open and an angry monster lunges at you. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.success: You decide not to get involved in trouble.
o2.failure: You walk past, but danger is waiting ahead.

vending-machine.name: Vending Machine
vending-machine.description: As you wander through the ship, you find a vending machine with someone’s food still inside.

o1.success: You wrench your hand free with the food. Restore 2 health.
o1.failure: Your hand gets stuck in the machine. When you finally get free, you see a monster approaching. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

pile-of-things.name: Pile of Things
pile-of-things.description: You enter a room and see a pile of objects that might contain something useful.

o1.success: You find a suitable weapon. Draw an Item card.
o1.failure: Something moves among the objects. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.action: Leave the pile alone and leave the room.
o2.success: You get away from the strange pile in time.
o2.failure: A monster notices you before you can leave. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

monster-nest.name: Monster Lair
monster-nest.description: You have found a creature’s lair. There must be something interesting inside.

o1.success: After defeating the monster, draw 1 Supply card.
o1.failure: Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.success: You enter the lair and leave with supplies without being noticed. Draw a Supply card.
o2.failure: The noise wakes a sleeping monster. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o3.success: Discard a Gas Cylinder. The blast destroys the lair; draw a Supply card.
o3.failure: Discard a Gas Cylinder, but the blast attracts a monster. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

corpse.name: Crew Member’s Corpse
corpse.description: Searching the ship, you spot a person. As you get closer, you realize it is a corpse.

o1.success: You put the family photo back and take an Old Cloak from the Special Items deck.
o1.failure: You cannot get away in time: the corpse reanimates. Draw a Restless card and fight it.

o2.action: Leave the corpse alone and search the room.
o2.success: You leave the body alone and find supplies. Draw a Supply card.
o2.failure: The corpse reanimates behind you. Draw a Restless card and fight it.

suitcases.name: Suitcases of the Dead
suitcases.description: You find a pile of suitcases that belonged to deceased crew members.

o1.success: You find a few credits in the suitcases. Gain 5 credits.
o1.failure: A monster has made its home inside. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.success: You walk past, and it was the right choice: a monster runs by.
o2.failure: You disturb the monster after all. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

hatch-monster.name: Monster in the Hatch
hatch-monster.description: While searching for supplies, you slide open a hatch and see a monster hiding inside.

o1.action: Slip past it to the supplies.
o1.success: The monster is distracted by the noise. Draw 2 Supply cards.
o1.failure: The monster spots you. Take 3 damage and perform 1 fewer action next turn.

o2.action: Close the hatch and search elsewhere.
o2.success: You close the hatch and find a package nearby. Draw a Supply card.
o2.failure: As you leave, the noise attracts a monster. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

security-room.name: Security Room
security-room.description: You enter a security room. The alarm is still active.

o1.success: You grab the first thing you see. Draw an Item card.
o1.failure: The alarm attracts a monster. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.success: You search the room undisturbed. Draw the top 3 Item cards, choose 1, and shuffle the rest back into the deck.
o2.failure: The alarm attracts a monster. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

exposed-wires.name: Exposed Wires
exposed-wires.description: The wiring in the corridor ahead is damaged. Bare wires touch the floor.

o1.success: You cross to the other end of the room.
o1.failure: You touch a wire and take 2 damage.

o2.action: Find the power source and shut it off.
o2.success: The power is off, and you pass safely.
o2.failure: You touch a wire and take 2 damage.

o3.success: You avoid the wires, but meet a monster on your way back. Draw a Monster card and fight it.
o3.failure: Draw a Monster card and fight it.

monster-pack.name: Pack Around the Corner
monster-pack.description: You hear growling and the footsteps of a group of monsters coming toward you from around the corner.

o1.success: You hide and the pack passes by.
o1.failure: One of the monsters spots you. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.failure: You run into another enemy. Move to an adjacent sector, draw a Monster card, and fight it.
